title: How often should I book AC maintenance in Al Rashidiya?

title: Why is my air conditioner taking longer to cool?
desc:
Common reasons include:
  • Dirty air filters
  • Low refrigerant gas
  • Blocked condenser coil
  • Poor airflow

title: What causes an AC to leak water?
desc:
Usually because of:
